## كلمات مفتاحية وعبارات عامية

دليل إجراءات تقنية المعلومات، الإصدار السادس، تاريخ السريان، أكاديمية السعودية، موافقة، اعتماد، تصديق، مين يعتمد، مين يوافق، الدليل، دليل الإجراءات، المانيوال، الكتيب، سجل، تسجيل، ريكورد، وثيقة، الهيكل التنظيمي، التنظيم، التبعية، مين يتبع مين، متى بدأ، من متى مطبق، الإصدار، النسخة، أي إصدار، اختصار، وش يعني، معنى الاختصار، نموذج، فورم، استمارة، ابغى دليل إجراءات تقنية المعلومات، ابي دليل إجراءات تقنية المعلومات، وش دليل إجراءات تقنية المعلومات، كيف دليل إجراءات تقنية المعلومات، وين دليل إجراءات تقنية المعلومات، ابغى الإصدار السادس، ابي الإصدار السادس، وش الإصدار السادس، كيف الإصدار السادس، وين الإصدار السادس، ابغى تاريخ السريان، ابي تاريخ السريان، وش تاريخ السريان

# Manual Approval and Amendment Requirements

Document: Information Technology Office Procedure Manual
Edition: 6th Edition
Effective date: 21 NOV 2024
Retrieval group ID: SEC-1.2
Group type: Governance
Chapter: 1
Section: 1.2
Source page(s): 5
System(s) or asset(s): IT OPM
Responsible role(s): Head of Information Technology Department, IT Section Manager / IT Manager, All IT Personnel, Information Technology Services Staff, Bandar Najdi Manager IT D

## Arabic Search Terms

اعتماد الدليل، تعديل الدليل، موافقة المدير العام، التعديلات المالية والتوظيف

## Records

- Edition Approval Basis [REC-009; Approval Statement]
  The edition was approved after the review update and approval process of the documented procedure Control of SA Documents
  Reference or recipient: Control of SA Documents

- Major Manual Revision [REC-010; Approval Requirement]
  The Head of the Information Technology Department shall obtain Managing Director approval before a major manual revision
  Responsible role: Head of Information Technology Department | Trigger or condition: Before a major manual revision | Evidence or record: Approval | Reference or recipient: Managing Director

- Financial Changes [REC-011; Approval Requirement]
  The Head of the Information Technology Department shall obtain Managing Director approval before financial changes
  Responsible role: Head of Information Technology Department | Trigger or condition: Before financial changes | Evidence or record: Approval | Reference or recipient: Managing Director

- Recruitment Changes [REC-012; Approval Requirement]
  The Head of the Information Technology Department shall obtain Managing Director approval before recruitment changes
  Responsible role: Head of Information Technology Department | Trigger or condition: Before recruitment changes | Evidence or record: Approval | Reference or recipient: Managing Director

# KPI Framework and Requirements

Document: Information Technology Office Procedure Manual
Edition: 6th Edition
Effective date: 21 NOV 2024
Retrieval group ID: SEC-2.1.1
Group type: Quality
Chapter: 2
Section: 2.1.1
Source page(s): 21
System(s) or asset(s): Freshdesk Support Tickets, IT Tickets
Responsible role(s): Management, IT Specialist

## Arabic Search Terms

مؤشرات الأداء، KPI، زمن الاستجابة، نسبة إغلاق التذاكر، الإجراءات التصحيحية

## Records

- Definition of KPI [REC-064; KPI Definition]
  A KPI is a metric or measure used to quantify and evaluate organizational and achievement success

- KPI Uses [REC-065; KPI Purpose]
  KPIs are used to set measurable objectives evaluate progress monitor trends make improvements and support decision making

- Management Alert [REC-066; KPI Requirement]
  A KPI measurement shall alert management if there are impending problems in a Key Performance Area
  Responsible role: Management | Trigger or condition: Impending problems in a Key Performance Area

a. Specific Measurement Data [REC-067; KPI Component]
  The indicator consists of specific measurement data
  Parent record: REC-066

b. Predetermined Standard [REC-068; KPI Component]
  The indicator consists of a predetermined standard against which the data will be compared
  Parent record: REC-066

- Average Response Time to Support Tickets [REC-069; KPI]
  Average response time to support tickets shall be within two working days of ticket creation
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk Support Tickets | Frequency or timing: Measured from ticket creation | Target or threshold: Within 2 working days | Evidence or record: KPI Records / Support Ticket Timestamps

- IT Ticket Closure Rate [REC-070; KPI]
  Maintain a minimum closure rate of 97 percent for IT tickets per year
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: IT Tickets | Frequency or timing: Per year | Target or threshold: Minimum 97 percent | Evidence or record: KPI Records

- Failure to Meet KPI Goals [REC-071; Corrective Action Requirement]
  Failure to meet established KPI goals will be addressed by starting problem solving and an appropriate improvement method
  Trigger or condition: When an established KPI goal is not met | Evidence or record: Problem Solving / Improvement Record

## Source Records

REC-064, REC-065, REC-066, REC-067, REC-068, REC-069, REC-070, REC-071

# Freshdesk Ticketing System

فريش ديسك، Freshdesk، تذاكر الدعم، فتح تذكرة، متابعة التذاكر، إغلاق التذكرة

## Records

- Freshdesk Subscription [REC-079; System Description]
  Saudia Academy subscribes to the Freshdesk cloud-based support ticketing system
  System or asset: Freshdesk

- Freshdesk Purpose [REC-080; System Purpose]
  Freshdesk is used to receive follow and manage all IT defect ticket records
  System or asset: Freshdesk | Evidence or record: IT Defect Ticket Records

- Freshdesk Account Administrator [REC-081; System Role Assignment]
  The Manager IT is the Freshdesk Account Administrator
  Responsible role: Manager IT | System or asset: Freshdesk

- Freshdesk Agents [REC-082; System Role Assignment]
  All other IT team members are assigned as Freshdesk Agents
  Responsible role: All Other IT Team Members | System or asset: Freshdesk

- Freshdesk Account Link [REC-083; System Access Reference]
  Access to Saudia Academy's Freshdesk account is through the stated URL
  System or asset: Freshdesk | Reference or recipient: https://princesultanaviationacademysaudiairlines.freshdesk.com/

- Continuously Check New Tickets [REC-084; Ticket Monitoring Requirement]
  All IT Specialists are requested to continuously check Freshdesk for newly opened tickets
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Frequency or timing: Continuously | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

- Follow and Close Old Tickets [REC-085; Ticket Follow-up Requirement]
  All IT Specialists are requested to follow and close old tickets
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Frequency or timing: Continuously | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

- Open Ticket by Email [REC-086; Ticket Creation Method]
  A beneficiary can open a support ticket by sending an email to itsupport@psaa.com.sa
  Responsible role: Beneficiary Staff or Trainee | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Support request | Evidence or record: Support Ticket | Reference or recipient: itsupport@psaa.com.sa

- Automatic Ticket Creation and Reply [REC-087; System Automation]
  Freshdesk automatically opens a ticket and replies to the requester with the ticket number
  System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Email sent to itsupport@psaa.com.sa | Evidence or record: Ticket Number Email

- Document Verbal Requests [REC-088; Ticket Documentation Requirement]
  The IT Specialist is responsible for opening tickets for support requests received verbally
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Verbal support request | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

- Document Classroom and Lab Calls [REC-089; Ticket Documentation Requirement]
  The IT Specialist is responsible for opening tickets for calls received from running classrooms and labs
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Call from a running classroom or lab | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

- Document Walk-in Requests [REC-090; Ticket Documentation Requirement]
  The IT Specialist is responsible for opening tickets for walk-in support requests
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Walk-in support request | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

- Document Routine Check Defects [REC-091; Ticket Documentation Requirement]
  The IT Specialist is responsible for opening tickets for defects found during routine checks
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Defect found during a routine check | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

## Records

1. Receive Ticket [REC-111; Process Step]
  The IT Specialist receives tickets in the Freshdesk system
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

2. Define Asset or Process Ownership [REC-112; Process Step]
  The IT Specialist determines whether the asset or process is owned by SVIT or Saudia Academy
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

2A. SVIT-Owned Asset or Process [REC-113; Process Step]
  If the asset or process is owned by SVIT advise the user to contact SVIT and proceed to step 7
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Asset or process is owned by SVIT | Evidence or record: Support Ticket | Reference or recipient: SVIT | Parent record: REC-112

2B. Academy IT-Owned Asset or Process [REC-114; Process Step]
  If the asset or process is owned by Academy IT proceed to the next step
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Asset or process is owned by Academy IT | Evidence or record: Support Ticket | Parent record: REC-112

3. Identify Cause [REC-115; Process Step]
  The IT Specialist identifies the cause of the problem
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

4. Determine Solution [REC-116; Process Step]
  The IT Specialist determines the solution
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

5. Apply Solution [REC-117; Process Step]
  The IT Specialist applies the solution
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

6. Confirm Fix [REC-118; Process Step]
  The IT Specialist confirms whether the problem is fixed
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

6A. Problem Not Fixed [REC-119; Process Step]
  If the problem is not fixed return to step 3
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Problem is not fixed | Evidence or record: Support Ticket | Parent record: REC-118

6B. Problem Fixed [REC-120; Process Step]
  If the problem is fixed proceed to the next step
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Problem is fixed | Evidence or record: Support Ticket | Parent record: REC-118

7. Update and Close Ticket [REC-121; Process Step]
  The IT Specialist updates and closes the ticket
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

Chapter: 3
Section: 3.2

## Arabic Search Terms

## Records

1. Receive Request [REC-122; Process Step]
  The IT Specialist receives a Freshdesk ticket raised by the Training Department
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Request raised by Training Department | Evidence or record: Support Ticket | Reference or recipient: Training Department

2. Check Form Completeness [REC-123; Process Step]
  The IT Specialist checks whether the provided New Path Creation form is complete
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: New Path Creation Form | Evidence or record: New Path Creation Form

2A. Incomplete Form [REC-124; Process Step]
  If the form is incomplete advise the requester to complete the form and raise the request again
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Form is incomplete | Evidence or record: Support Ticket / New Path Creation Form | Reference or recipient: Requester | Parent record: REC-123

2B. Complete Form [REC-125; Process Step]
  If the form is complete proceed to the next step
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: New Path Creation Form | Trigger or condition: Form is complete | Evidence or record: New Path Creation Form | Parent record: REC-123

3. Build New Path [REC-126; Process Step]
  The IT Specialist builds the new path in TMS
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: TMS | Evidence or record: New Path

4. Review New Path [REC-127; Process Step]
  The IT Specialist reviews the newly created path and ensures that no data is missing
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: TMS | Evidence or record: Reviewed New Path

4A. Check Department Name [REC-128; Process Step]
  The review shall include the Department Name
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: TMS | Evidence or record: Reviewed New Path | Parent record: REC-127

4B. Check Path Duration [REC-129; Process Step]
  The review shall include the Path Duration
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: TMS | Evidence or record: Reviewed New Path | Parent record: REC-127

4C. Check Minimum Attendees [REC-130; Process Step]
  The review shall include the minimum number of attendees
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: TMS | Evidence or record: Reviewed New Path | Parent record: REC-127

4D. Check Maximum Attendees [REC-131; Process Step]
  The review shall include the maximum number of attendees
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: TMS | Evidence or record: Reviewed New Path | Parent record: REC-127

5. Notify Sales and Marketing [REC-132; Process Step]
  The IT Specialist sends an email stating that a new path has been created and provides the path name and path code
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Email | Evidence or record: Notification Email | Reference or recipient: psaasales@saudia.com

5A. Copy Training Department [REC-133; Process Step]
  The Training Department is copied on the notification email
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Email | Evidence or record: Notification Email | Reference or recipient: Training Department | Parent record: REC-132

6. Update and Close Ticket [REC-134; Process Step]
  The IT Specialist updates and closes the ticket
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: New Path Creation Form | Evidence or record: New Path Creation Form

  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: New Path Creation Form | Trigger or condition: Form is complete | Evidence or record: New Path Creation Form | Parent record: REC-123

  The IT Specialist builds the new path in TMS

  The IT Specialist reviews the newly created path and ensures that no data is missing

  Daily routine checks on the EDRAK system will be conducted by the IT Specialist
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK | Frequency or timing: Daily

2. Use of F02 Form [REC-136; Routine Policy]
  The EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card form number F02 is used to document daily routine activities
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02

3. Form Soft Copy Location [REC-137; Routine Policy]
  A soft copy of the EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card is available in the stated folder
  System or asset: EDRAK | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: PSAA Share File/Information Technology/Forms

4. Print Monthly Card [REC-138; Routine Policy]
  The IT Specialist prints a copy of the EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card at the beginning of each month
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK | Frequency or timing: Beginning of each month | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02

5. Complete Card Daily [REC-139; Routine Policy]
  The printed form is completed daily using the daily routine checklist
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02

6. Scan Completed Card [REC-140; Routine Policy]
  At the end of each month the EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card is scanned to the stated records folder
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK | Frequency or timing: End of each month | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: PSAA Share File/Information Technology/EDRAK Maintenance Routine Card Records

7. Open Ticket for Issues [REC-141; Routine Policy]
  The IT Specialist shall open a Freshdesk ticket for any issue found during a daily routine check
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Issue found during daily routine check | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

8. Communication Room Access [REC-142; Access Requirement]
  Only Saudia Academy IT personnel shall have access to the Communication Room on the first floor
  Responsible role: SA IT Personnel | System or asset: Communication Room | Frequency or timing: Ongoing | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

## Records

1. Stations Powered On [REC-143; Daily Check]
  Make sure all stations are on
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: CBT Stations | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: CBT Labs Second Floor

2. Peripheral Connection and Condition [REC-144; Daily Check]
  Make sure the headset mouse and keyboard are connected and nothing is broken
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Headset Mouse and Keyboard | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: CBT Labs Second Floor

3. EDRAK Software Running [REC-145; Daily Check]
  Make sure EDRAK software is running on all stations
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK Software | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: CBT Labs Second Floor

4. Server Error Messages [REC-146; Daily Check]
  Check whether there are error messages on the EDRAK servers
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK Servers | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

5. Server and Switch Indicators [REC-147; Daily Check]
  Confirm that all indicator lights on all switches and servers are green and that there are no red lights
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Servers and Switches | Frequency or timing: Daily | Target or threshold: All green and no red light | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

6. Server Cabinet Fans [REC-148; Daily Check]
  Make sure all server cabinet fans are operating properly and are clean
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Server Cabinet Fans | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

7. Room Temperature and Airflow [REC-149; Daily Check]
  Make sure the room temperature is between 18 and 24 degrees Celsius and that air-conditioning flow is acceptable
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Communication Room | Frequency or timing: Daily | Target or threshold: 18-24 degrees Celsius | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

8. Room Cleanliness and Cable Security [REC-150; Daily Check]
  Make sure the Communication Room is clean free of dust and debris tidy and that all wires are secured
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Communication Room | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

9. EDRAK Data Backup [REC-151; Daily Check]
  Conduct an EDRAK data backup
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

9.1. Log in to SQL Virtual Machine [REC-152; Backup Step]
  Log in to the SQL virtual machine from the H1 server
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: H1 Server / SQL Virtual Machine | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor | Parent record: REC-151

9.2. Open Backup Scripts [REC-153; Backup Step]
  Open the two backup scripts in C drive using MSSQL
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: MSSQL Backup Scripts | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: C Drive | Parent record: REC-151

9.3. Update Backup File Date [REC-154; Backup Step]
  Change the file name in the script to today's date
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Backup Script | Frequency or timing: Daily | Target or threshold: Current date | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Parent record: REC-151

9.4. Run Backup Script [REC-155; Backup Step]
  Run the backup script
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: MSSQL Backup Script | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Parent record: REC-151

9.5. Copy to H3 SQL Virtual Machine [REC-156; Backup Step]
  Copy the backup files to the H3 SQL virtual machine
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: H3 SQL Virtual Machine | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: H3 SQL Virtual Machine | Parent record: REC-151

9.6. Copy to External Hard Drive [REC-157; Backup Step]
  Copy the backup files to the external hard drive
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: External Hard Drive | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: External Hard Drive | Parent record: REC-151

- Interrupted or Incomplete Routine Task [REC-158; Exception Documentation Requirement]
  When a routine task is interrupted or cannot be completed within its timeframe an appropriate comment shall be written in the remark field of the routine maintenance card
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | Trigger or condition: Routine task interrupted or not completed within its timeframe | Evidence or record: Remark Field on CBT Routine Maintenance Card

## Records

1. Stations Powered On [REC-143; Daily Check]
  Make sure all stations are on
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: CBT Stations | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: CBT Labs Second Floor

2. Peripheral Connection and Condition [REC-144; Daily Check]
  Make sure the headset mouse and keyboard are connected and nothing is broken
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Headset Mouse and Keyboard | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: CBT Labs Second Floor

3. EDRAK Software Running [REC-145; Daily Check]
  Make sure EDRAK software is running on all stations
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK Software | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: CBT Labs Second Floor

4. Server Error Messages [REC-146; Daily Check]
  Check whether there are error messages on the EDRAK servers
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK Servers | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

5. Server and Switch Indicators [REC-147; Daily Check]
  Confirm that all indicator lights on all switches and servers are green and that there are no red lights
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Servers and Switches | Frequency or timing: Daily | Target or threshold: All green and no red light | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

6. Server Cabinet Fans [REC-148; Daily Check]
  Make sure all server cabinet fans are operating properly and are clean
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Server Cabinet Fans | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

7. Room Temperature and Airflow [REC-149; Daily Check]
  Make sure the room temperature is between 18 and 24 degrees Celsius and that air-conditioning flow is acceptable
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Communication Room | Frequency or timing: Daily | Target or threshold: 18-24 degrees Celsius | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

8. Room Cleanliness and Cable Security [REC-150; Daily Check]
  Make sure the Communication Room is clean free of dust and debris tidy and that all wires are secured
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Communication Room | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

9. EDRAK Data Backup [REC-151; Daily Check]
  Conduct an EDRAK data backup
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

9.1. Log in to SQL Virtual Machine [REC-152; Backup Step]
  Log in to the SQL virtual machine from the H1 server
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: H1 Server / SQL Virtual Machine | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor | Parent record: REC-151

9.2. Open Backup Scripts [REC-153; Backup Step]
  Open the two backup scripts in C drive using MSSQL
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: MSSQL Backup Scripts | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: C Drive | Parent record: REC-151

9.3. Update Backup File Date [REC-154; Backup Step]
  Change the file name in the script to today's date
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Backup Script | Frequency or timing: Daily | Target or threshold: Current date | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Parent record: REC-151

9.4. Run Backup Script [REC-155; Backup Step]
  Run the backup script
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: MSSQL Backup Script | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Parent record: REC-151

9.5. Copy to H3 SQL Virtual Machine [REC-156; Backup Step]
  Copy the backup files to the H3 SQL virtual machine
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: H3 SQL Virtual Machine | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: H3 SQL Virtual Machine | Parent record: REC-151

9.6. Copy to External Hard Drive [REC-157; Backup Step]
  Copy the backup files to the external hard drive
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: External Hard Drive | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: External Hard Drive | Parent record: REC-151

- Interrupted or Incomplete Routine Task [REC-158; Exception Documentation Requirement]
  When a routine task is interrupted or cannot be completed within its timeframe an appropriate comment shall be written in the remark field of the routine maintenance card
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | Trigger or condition: Routine task interrupted or not completed within its timeframe | Evidence or record: Remark Field on CBT Routine Maintenance Card
